title: Introduce Pluggable Leader Strategy Interface
description:
Context

The current swarm system uses a fixed heuristic leader algorithm for exploration task assignment. The leader directly decides which explorer should receive which frontier/anchor target based on hardcoded scoring logic inside the leader task-management functions.

This works well enough as a deterministic baseline. However, the goal of the project is to compare different AI-based leader strategies against this baseline and evaluate whether AI improves swarm exploration behavior.

To make this comparison clean and fair, the leader decision logic must be separated from the rest of the swarm infrastructure. All strategies should receive the same leader-side world state and produce the same type of decision output. The existing heuristic algorithm must remain available as Strategy 0 / baseline.

Goal

Create a pluggable leader strategy layer that allows the build configuration to select which leader decision strategy is used.
